title: Script and caption of a short video post

tasks.title: The script and the caption
tasks.text: write the script and the caption of the short video post this request describes (a Reel, a TikTok or a Short), as a post file in docs/marketing/content/, from its slot in docs/marketing/calendar.md when the calendar has one, or else from the request. Text only: nothing is recorded, edited or published here. Every number and claim in the script and the caption comes from a document of the project or from the person; ask the person for the material and the platform when the request does not give them, and never invent either.
